description: Batch sizes of the KernelBench level 2 problem 40 linear layer (4096 x 4096 weight); the original five cases (2048 to 32768 rows) are extended down to 256 rows for a 128x performance span. Batches 1, 3, 100 and 1000 are correctness-only boundary shapes; batch 100 is also checked with a non-default scaling_factor of 2.0.
